restrictions: Use one batch of n=ceil(9943*2^128/10000) iid uniform 36-byte messages BE32(u)||BE4(w); identical inputs at the first included repeated digest cause FAIL; no restart.
Use standard-IV SHA-256 indices 0 through 30 on the single padded block, full feed-forward, and all 256 output bits; one selected compression per trial.
Draw one fresh uniform 256-bit setup mask R independently of all message coins; use it only as the sparse-address translation.

Reserve the low word-address interval [0,2^130) for dense arrays, code, scratch, and fixed state; use the table complement [2^130,2^256) for sparse cells, with every cell reserved and address arithmetic and native branches charged.
Stop at the first included repeated digest; return FAIL if the repeated inputs are identical, otherwise rehash and verify the collision.
Use at most 71 ordinary operations per sample, plus 2^20 setup and 2^14 terminal verification/output operations; preprocessing is included in total time.
This is a physically infeasible analytic construction with no experiment, computed witness, hidden search, PRNG independence premise, or practical-collision claim.
